purpose: figures of the manuscript from the completed stage-3 models; no training or re-scoring; the verdict not_met is unchanged

rule.fixed_models: pair xcb_xcl (first registered pair); per arm the seed of the archived validation-based selection (followup.json: highest recorded validation video AUC, ties to the smaller seed); I2 = the checkpoint of P with k = 0
rule.population: the L videos of each dataset (anomalous test videos with both classes)
rule.delta: d_v = Precision@10%(P) - Precision@10%(I2) of the fixed P checkpoint, per video
rule.ubn_helped: largest d_v (an extreme of the distribution, not a representative case)
rule.ubn_typical: video closest to the median of d_v
rule.ubn_worsened: smallest d_v (an extreme of the distribution)
rule.ucf_typical: video closest to the median of d_v
rule.xdv_typical: video closest to the median of d_v
rule.ubn_normal: first normal test video (manifest order) of the scene of the helped case
rule.timeline_frames: N_TIMELINE snippets j_i = floor((i + 1/2) J / N_TIMELINE); the shown frame of a snippet is its fifth encoder input, min(16 j + 8, T - 1)
rule.review_frames: every snippet with a positive share in the top-10% selection of the arm, in time order; the boundary group carries its fractional share
rule.input_figure: the helped UBnormal case; the full-length snippet ranked first by P and the last (shorter) snippet, with all their encoder input frames
rule.input_figure_amendment: first written as 'the typical UBnormal case'; amended after the first run because that case has 9 snippets and a budget of 13.1 frames (below one snippet), which cannot show a ranking of several snippets; the case choice itself is unchanged
